name: The Companies API
description: Company enrichment and search by domain, name, or attributes.

methods.label: Enrich Company by Domain
methods.description: Enrich a company from its domain (e.g. 'stripe.com'). Returns ~80 nested datapoints: about.name, about.industry, about.totalEmployees, domain.domain, locations.headquarters, socials, technologies.active, finances.revenue, descriptions.primary, assets.logoSquare, etc. 1 credit.

simplified.description: Return a smaller payload (free, no extra credits)

methods.label: Enrich Company by Email
methods.description: Enrich a company from a work email address (e.g. 'jane@stripe.com') — extracts the domain and returns the full company object (same shape as enrichByDomain). Use when you have an email but not the domain. 1 credit.

methods.label: Find Company by Name
methods.description: Look up a company by its name (e.g. 'Stripe'). Returns matching company object(s) — names aren't unique so multiple may return.

exactWordsMatch.description: Require all words to match exactly

countries.description: Comma-separated country codes to filter, e.g. 'us,gb'

methods.label: Enrich Company by Social URL
methods.description: Enrich a company from one of its social network profile URLs. Pass whichever you have (linkedin is most useful for GTM). Returns the full company object. 1 credit.

methods.label: Search Companies by Attributes
methods.description: Search the full company database with structured boolean conditions (industry, size, location, technology, revenue, etc.). Pass `query` as a JSON-encoded array of condition objects. Returns { companies[], meta, query }. 1 credit per company returned. Use for building target lists, not single-company lookups.

query.description: JSON-stringified+encoded array of condition objects (the segmentation filter). Build via promptToSegmentation if you have natural language.

search.description: Free-text query on company name or domain

searchFields.description: Which fields the `search` term applies to

simplified.description: Return preview data without full credit deduction

methods.label: Search Companies by Prompt
methods.description: Search companies with a natural-language prompt (e.g. 'B2B SaaS companies in Germany with 50-200 employees using Salesforce'). The API converts it to a segmentation filter and returns matching { companies[], meta }. Easier than building a `query` array by hand. 1 credit per company returned.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the companies to find

listsToExclude.description: Comma-separated list IDs whose companies to exclude

simplified.description: Preview data without full credit deduction

methods.label: Find Similar Companies
methods.description: Given one or more seed domains, return companies similar to them (lookalike search). Pass `domains` comma-separated. Returns { companies[], meta }. 1 credit per company returned. Use to expand a target account list from known good-fit accounts.

simplified.description: Preview data without full credit deduction

methods.label: Count Companies Matching a Filter
methods.description: Return the total count of companies matching a segmentation `query` (and/or `search`) WITHOUT returning records — use to size a market/segment before paying to fetch. Returns { count }. Cheap (does not bill per-company).

searchFields.description: Which fields the `search` term applies to

methods.label: Ask a Question About a Company
methods.description: Ask a free-text question about a company (by domain) and get a structured AI answer (e.g. 'Does this company sell to enterprise?'). Define the output shape via `fields`. Returns { answer, meta }. Great for custom enrichment columns the standard datapoints don't cover. 1 credit.

question.description: The question to answer about the company

fields.description: Array of { key, type, description } objects defining the structured answer shape

methods.label: Fetch Company Context
methods.description: Get the full text context (crawled site content + profile) for a company by domain — the raw material the AI uses. Returns a large context blob. Useful to feed your own LLM column. 1 credit.

methods.label: Get Company Email Patterns
methods.description: Get the email-format patterns a company uses (e.g. {first}.{last}@domain.com) with usage percentages. Returns the pattern, not specific people's emails. 1 credit.

emailsCount.description: Number of example emails to base patterns on

methods.label: Search Industries
methods.description: Search the industry taxonomy by keyword. Returns { industries[] } with the canonical industry identifiers used in segmentation `query` filters. Use to resolve a human industry name to a valid filter value. Free/cheap.

methods.label: Search Technologies
methods.description: Search the technology taxonomy by keyword (e.g. 'salesforce', 'react'). Returns { technologies[] } with canonical identifiers used in segmentation `query` filters (technographic targeting). Free/cheap.

methods.label: Search Countries
methods.description: Search/resolve countries for use in location segmentation filters. Returns { countries[] } with canonical codes. Free/cheap. (Sister endpoints exist for cities/states/counties/continents.)

methods.label: Search Cities
methods.description: Search/resolve cities for use in location segmentation filters. Returns { cities[] } with canonical identifiers. Free/cheap.

filters.description: Additional filter conditions (e.g. restrict to a country)

methods.label: Enrich a Job Title
methods.description: Normalize/classify a raw job title (e.g. 'VP Sales EMEA') into seniority, department, and canonical role. Returns the structured job-title enrichment. 1 credit.

name.description: Raw job title to enrich, e.g. 'VP of Sales'

methods.label: Convert Prompt to Segmentation Filter
methods.description: Turn a natural-language description into the structured segmentation `query` array used by searchCompanies / countCompanies. Returns the filter object. Use this first when you only have a prose ICP, then feed the result into searchCompanies. 1 credit.

context.description: Extra context to guide the conversion

force.description: Force regeneration instead of using a cached result

methods.label: Fetch Account / Credits
methods.description: Get the current API account info including remaining credit balance. Returns the user object. Free.

methods.label: List Company Lists
methods.description: Fetch the team's saved company lists (paginated). Returns { lists[], meta } where each list has { id, name }. Backs the list-picker fields (listId, listsToExclude).
